head.title: Wedding Catering Cost Dubai: What to Budget in 2026 | myCHEF
head.meta_description: Wedding catering cost in Dubai starts from around AED 700 per guest for plated service. What buffets, stations and luxury menus really cost, and how to budget by guest count.
head.h1: Wedding Catering Cost in Dubai: What It Costs to Feed Your Guests

opening_paragraph: Wedding catering cost in Dubai starts from around AED 700 per guest for plated service, and that is where myCHEF's quotes begin. Buffets and grazing stations usually work out lower per head, while a multi-course plated dinner with full front-of-house service sits at the top of the range. The honest answer is that no two weddings cost the same, because the number turns on guest count, menu tier, how the food is served and the extras you add on top.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: What does wedding catering cost in Dubai, really?
replace_in_block.new_heading: What does wedding catering cost in Dubai, really?
new_paragraphs: As a working range, plated wedding catering in Dubai starts near AED 700 per guest, climbs to roughly AED 950 per guest for a fuller menu, and rises further for a luxury multi-course tasting. Buffets and grazing tables generally sit below the plated figure. Those are food-and-service numbers; quotes are usually shown before the standard 5% VAT, and a venue may add its own service charge on top. Because so much rides on your choices, treat any single "average" you read online with caution and get a real quote against your own guest list.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Plated, buffet or stations: which format costs more?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Plated, buffet or stations: which format costs more?
new_paragraphs: Plated service is the most expensive format per head, and for a clear reason. A wedding buffet catering setup lets guests serve themselves from a spread, so you need fewer waiters and the kitchen can batch-cook. Live stations sit in the middle, offering theatre without full table service. A plated dinner needs more chefs and service staff timed to each course, which is what pushes the wedding catering price per head up. If you want the feel of fine dining on a tighter wedding caterer budget, a hybrid works well: plated starters and dessert with sharing platters in the middle.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: What is included in a wedding catering package?
replace_in_block.new_heading: What is included in a wedding catering package?
new_paragraphs: A proper wedding catering package should cover menu design and a tasting, the chefs and service staff, plating and styling, plus setup and cleanup. The wedding food catering line most people forget is labour: on a wedding day you are paying for a team, not just ingredients. Confirm exactly which wedding catering services are inside the quote and which are extras, because rentals, a bar, a cake or a dessert table are often priced separately. A clear itemised proposal is the sign of a caterer worth booking; a single lump sum with no breakdown is not.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: The lines that sit outside the per-head price
replace_in_block.new_heading: The lines that sit outside the per-head price
new_paragraphs: Two things routinely surprise couples. The first is tax: every catering invoice in the UAE carries 5% VAT, which the UAE Ministry of Finance introduced across the country on 1 January 2018. A proposal that does not show it as its own line is incomplete instead of cheaper, and on a wedding-sized total that difference is worth seeing before you sign.

The second is everything that is not food. Staffing is sometimes quoted separately, which makes one headline look lower than an identical brief beside it. Rentals — crockery, glassware, linen, furniture — are frequently excluded at venues that have none. A temporary kitchen is typically an extra where the venue has no kitchen. Then the quiet ones: vendor meals for photographers and musicians, children’s portions, waste removal where the venue requires everything to leave, and overtime if the reception runs past the contracted hours. Ask for the quote itemised into food, staffing, rentals, delivery and VAT, and compare totals instead of per-head figures.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: How does guest count change the price per head?
replace_in_block.new_heading: How does guest count change the price per head?
new_paragraphs: Larger receptions bring the wedding catering cost per person down, up to a point. Fixed costs such as kitchen setup, delivery and a core service team are spread across more covers, so a 150-guest reception often has a lower per-head figure than a 40-person dinner of the same menu. That is why wedding catering prices in Dubai are almost typically quoted once the caterer knows your headcount and venue. If your numbers are still moving, ask for a quote at two guest counts so you can see how the cost of wedding catering in Dubai flexes as the list firms up.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: What pushes a luxury wedding catering bill higher?
replace_in_block.new_heading: What pushes a luxury wedding catering bill higher?
new_paragraphs: Premium ingredients and premium service are what separate a luxury wedding catering menu from a standard one. Think seafood towers, wagyu, a live pasta or shawarma station, a bespoke wedding catering menu built around your story, and a higher ratio of staff to guests for slick, unhurried service. Styling matters too: custom plating, linens and a styled dessert table read as luxury and carry a cost. For a lavish multi-course tasting at a headline venue, per-guest figures around AED 1,200 and full-service wedding packages from roughly AED 4,500 are realistic once you layer these in.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Can you do affordable or small wedding catering without cutting quality?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Can you do affordable or small wedding catering without cutting quality?
new_paragraphs: Yes, and the trick is format, not compromise. For affordable wedding catering in Dubai, a generous buffet or grazing stations delivers variety at a friendlier per-head cost than a plated banquet. Small wedding catering follows a different logic: an intimate villa dinner for a handful of guests is often built around a private-chef booking with a minimum event value instead of a low per-head rate, so the experience stays personal. Seasonal timing helps as well. Dubai's peak wedding season runs November to March, so a shoulder-month or midweek date can ease pressure on availability and pricing, per The Wedding Atelier .

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Who cooks it, and how are the chefs vetted?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Who cooks it, and how are the chefs vetted?
new_paragraphs: Your menu decides your chef. MyCHEF pairs weddings with cooks who fit the brief: Ahmed Al-Rashid for plated fine dining, Marco Rossi for Italian and Mediterranean sharing feasts, Layla Hassan for fully halal Arabic menus, and Matteo Moretti for the wedding cake and dessert table. Every chef goes through real vetting before working an event: verified identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification, and ongoing performance reviews after each booking. You can read the full process on how we vet our chefs . Food safety across Dubai catering is overseen by the Dubai Municipality Food Safety Department , which sets the hygiene standards caterers operate under.

Worth asking beyond the CV: food-safety training is not optional for people working in food here. ICCA Dubai sets out that every food handler, supervisor and Person in Charge operating under Dubai Municipality or another emirate authority must hold approved training, that each food business needs at least one certified Person in Charge carrying legal responsibility for compliance, and that certificates lapse after roughly three to five years and must be renewed. For a wedding, where the kitchen is often temporary and the guest count large, ask who the Person in Charge is and whether the handler certificates are current. UAE food safety sits under Federal Law No. 10 of 2015 per the UAE government portal , with the Food Safety Department monitoring establishments and investigating food-borne illness locally.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: How to get an accurate quote and when to book
replace_in_block.new_heading: How to get an accurate quote and when to book
new_paragraphs: The fastest route to a real number is to send your date, venue, guest count and preferred format, then sit down to a tasting before you commit. Peak season is the cooler window from November to March, when Dubai days average around 27°C and nights fall to about 19°C ( Weather and Climate ) and outdoor receptions work comfortably — which is also why a wedding reception catering slot then can be reserved six to twelve months out, so it pays to approach a wedding caterer in Dubai early instead of close to the date. Our wedding catering page and the planning checklist walk through the rest, and the prices guide gives wider context on catering costs across Dubai.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Planning wedding catering cost step by step
replace_in_block.new_heading: Planning wedding catering cost step by step
new_paragraphs: Send your date, guest count and venue — your wedding catering cost proposal arrives.
Book wedding catering cost about 2 weeks ahead off-peak, and 6 weeks ahead between November and March.
Confirm the menu for wedding catering cost some 7 days ahead, once numbers stop moving.
Ask for dietary covers at the wedding catering cost briefing stage instead of within 48 hours .
Check parking and lift access; your wedding catering cost team is on site some 2 hours early.
Plan on roughly 3 hours of wedding catering cost service, and add 5% VAT to the total.
How much does wedding catering cost per person in Dubai?

Plated wedding service typically starts from around AED 700 per guest and rises to roughly AED 950 to 1,200 per guest for multi-course tasting menus. Buffets and grazing stations usually sit lower per head, and the exact wedding catering cost per person depends on your guest count and menu tier.
Is a buffet cheaper than plated service for a wedding?

Usually yes. A wedding buffet or a set of live stations tends to cost less per head than a plated multi-course dinner, because plated service needs more chefs and waiters working to the timing of each course.
What is included in a wedding catering package?

A full wedding catering package should cover menu design and a tasting, the chefs and service staff, plating and styling, and setup and cleanup. Confirm which items sit inside the quote and which are extras, such as rentals, a bar or a dessert table.
How far in advance should I book a wedding caterer in Dubai?

Book early. Dubai's peak wedding season runs roughly November to March, and popular caterers and venues are often reserved six to twelve months ahead during those cooler months, so lock in your date and format once they are settled.
Do you cater small or intimate weddings?

Yes. MyCHEF handles small wedding catering as well as large receptions. Intimate dinners are often built around a private-chef format with a minimum event value, while larger receptions are quoted per head, which lowers the cost per guest as numbers rise.
Is the wedding food halal?

It can be. MyCHEF works with chefs such as Layla Hassan who cook fully halal Arabic and international menus, and every menu is confirmed with you in advance so it suits your guests and any dietary or cultural requirements.

Figures and rules in this article are drawn from official and industry sources, each checked to resolve: the UAE Ministry of Finance (5% VAT on catering, in force since 1 January 2018), Dubai Municipality (the Dubai Food Code, food-establishment requirements by activity, mandatory integrated training for food establishments, and rules for food transportation and delivery vehicles), the Food Safety Department (monitoring food establishments and investigating food-borne illness), the UAE government portal (UAE food safety under Federal Law No. 10 of 2015), ICCA Dubai (mandatory food-handler and Person-in-Charge training, and certificate renewal periods), Weather and Climate (Dubai December averages of 27°C by day and 19°C at night), and The Wedding Atelier (peak-season wedding booking lead times). Per-person figures are myCHEF’s own published rates. Confirm current requirements with these sources before you book.
